confirmClose.title: Close this brief?
confirmClose.text: Influencers won’t see it or be able to apply. You can reopen it later.

newLead: Only platform and country are required — post fast, refine later.

basics.title: What is the task?
basics.hint: Influencers decide in seconds — be concrete.

fields.title: Title
fields.titleHint: For example: Dinner for two for a Reels
fields.descriptionHint: What to show, key messages, hashtags, what not to do.
fields.collaborationHint: One promo, or an ongoing partnership.
fields.confidentialHint: Influencers see the brief without your name, logo or links. We show them only to influencers you accept.
fields.confidentialOn: Hidden until you accept an influencer
fields.citiesHint: Leave empty for the whole country.
fields.minEngagementHint: Lower engagement still sees the brief but gets a lower match.
fields.barterHint: For example: dinner for two, a skincare set.
fields.slotsHint: The brief closes when this many are accepted.

targeting.sizeHint: Followers on the platform the influencer applies with.
targeting.audienceHint: Used for the match score, not to hide influencers.

reachValue: {count, plural, one {# verified influencer} other {# verified influencers}}
reachZero: Try fewer filters or a wider audience size.
reachHint: Counts verified influencers who pass the location, platform, followers, gender and age filters.
reviewHint: We check every brief before influencers see it, usually within a day.

review.inReview: In review. We check every brief before influencers see it, usually within a day. You can still edit it.

cover.title: Cover image
cover.desc: A photo makes your brief stand out in the feed.

niches.title: Niches
niches.desc: Show the brief first to influencers in these topics.

engagement.title: Minimum engagement
engagement.desc: Skip accounts whose followers rarely like or comment.

influencer.title: Influencer gender and age
influencer.desc: Only influencers of this gender or age range can apply.

audience.title: Their audience
audience.desc: Prefer influencers whose followers match: gender, age, country. Used for the match score.

languages.title: Languages
languages.desc: Influencers who post in these languages.

barterValue.title: Value of the barter
barterValue.desc: Helps influencers see what the barter is worth.

publishBy.title: Post by a date
publishBy.desc: The date the post must be live by.

notEditable: This brief can’t be edited right now.

live.banner: This brief is live. Changing the deadline, the number of influencers or who it’s for keeps it live. Changing the title, description, image, formats or payment sends it for a quick review first.
live.note: The brief stays live with your changes.
live.reviewNote: You changed what we check, so the brief is hidden from new influencers until it’s approved, usually within a day. Applications you already have stay.
live.saved: Changes saved. The brief is live.

reopenFlow.lead: This brief is closed. Reopen it to change the deadline or anything else and publish it again. Applications you already have stay.
reopenFlow.needsDate: Set a new application deadline, then publish. If you only change dates, the number of influencers or targeting, it goes live right away.

emptyBody: Post a brief and influencers who fit will see it today.

toast.sentForReview: Sent for review. We will let you know when it is live.
toast.reopen: Brief reopened. Set a new deadline and publish.
